name: Square

tiers.how: Sage connects to Square via the Square Connect v2 REST API using an access token stored in the OS credential store. The owner must create a Square developer application in the Square Developer Dashboard, grant the required API permissions, and store the production access token via setup_creds. Reads are free; writes require approval.
always_tap: any invoice send or payment request to a client
any appointment booking on behalf of a client

gotchas: Square's Appointments API requires the APPOINTMENTS_WRITE permission scope; verify it is enabled in the developer dashboard.
Production and sandbox tokens are distinct; confirm which environment is configured.
Webhooks for payment events must be registered in the Square developer dashboard and the signature verified on receipt.
Some Square features (Appointments, Invoices) require specific Square account subscription tiers.
notes: Square suits businesses that combine in-person payments with scheduling; its Appointments feature overlaps with dedicated scheduling tools.
